{"candidate_rtl":"`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #
(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)
(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0]         input_unencoded,
    output wire                     output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0]         output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};

wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid[LEVELS-1:0];
wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc[LEVELS-1:0];

wire [WIDTH-1:0] scan[0:LEVELS];
assign scan[0] = input_unencoded;

generate
    genvar l, n, s, i;

    for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2+0];
        end else begin
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end

    for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
        for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2+0] ? {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2+0)*l]} : {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ? {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} : {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2+0)*l]};
            end
        end
    end

    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];

    if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : gen_lsb_priority
        for (s = 0; s < LEVELS; s = s + 1) begin : scan_level
            for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : scan_bit
                if (i >= (1 << s)) begin
                    assign scan[s+1][i] = scan[s][i] | scan[s][i-(1 << s)];
                end else begin
                    assign scan[s+1][i] = scan[s][i];
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = scan[LEVELS][WIDTH-1];
        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : encode_onehot
            if (i == 0) begin
                assign output_unencoded[i] = input_unencoded[i] | ~output_valid;
            end else begin
                assign output_unencoded[i] = input_unencoded[i] & ~scan[LEVELS][i-1];
            end
        end
    end else begin : gen_msb_priority
        for (s = 0; s < LEVELS; s = s + 1) begin : scan_level
            for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : scan_bit
                if (i + (1 << s) < WIDTH) begin
                    assign scan[s+1][i] = scan[s][i] | scan[s][i+(1 << s)];
                end else begin
                    assign scan[s+1][i] = scan[s][i];
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = scan[LEVELS][0];
        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : encode_onehot
            if (i == 0) begin
                assign output_unencoded[i] = (input_unencoded[i] & ~scan[LEVELS][i+1]) | ~output_valid;
            end else if (i == WIDTH-1) begin
                assign output_unencoded[i] = input_unencoded[i];
            end else begin
                assign output_unencoded[i] = input_unencoded[i] & ~scan[LEVELS][i+1];
            end
        end
    end
endgenerate

endmodule

","bottleneck":"The original critical path combines the eight-level priority tree with a subsequent encoded-to-onehot decode, producing roughly eleven mapped logic stages. The rewrite replaces the decoder cone with a balanced directional suffix-prefix OR scan and direct onehot qualification.","rewrite":"For the assessed MSB-priority instance, a logarithmic suffix OR network computes whether any higher-priority input is asserted. Each output onehot bit is then formed directly from its input and the corresponding higher-bit suffix result; bit zero additionally includes the original invalid/default behavior. The original priority encoder tree is retained for output_encoded and parameterized LSB-priority support is preserved.","expected_timing_gain":"The output_unencoded path should lose the separate encoded-to-onehot decode depth, reducing the worst data arrival from approximately 2.60 ns toward the depth of the eight-stage scan plus final qualification. The exact gain depends on SKY130HD mapping and buffering.","area_or_other_cost":"The scan uses a logarithmic parallel-prefix network with approximately WIDTH*log2(WIDTH) simple OR opportunities, so area may increase or remain comparable to the original decoder implementation. It stays within the stated area target if synthesis shares and maps the scan efficiently; no sequential, storage, or clock logic is added.","functional_boundaries":"The module name, ports, widths, signedness, parameter declarations/defaults, priority behavior, output_valid behavior, output_encoded behavior, and output_unencoded default of bit zero when no input is asserted are preserved. All input combinations are handled as arbitrary binary values, including zero input and multiple asserted inputs. The fixed assessed instance is WIDTH=256 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0."}
